title: Paperclip-ing ticket contract (fleet claim -> upstream issue)
description: The frozen ticket seam between the fleet's claim ledger (governance/dispatch/) and the upstream issue surface (issue #370, ADR-0013). A ticket has one accountable owner, a status in in-progress / blocked / in-review / done, explicit blocked-by relations, a goal reference and evidence. See docs/PAPERCLIP-ING-INTEGRATION.md.

id.description: Ticket identifier (fleet: the issue number as kushin77/agent-orchestrator#N).

owner.description: The single accountable agent that owns this ticket — never a set.

status.description: Ticket lifecycle state. done is a verdict, not a self-report.

blocked_by.description: Explicit blocked-by relations: the ticket ids this ticket waits on (empty when unblocked).

goal.description: Goal / milestone reference this ticket serves (fleet: the epic, e.g. EPIC-00 = issue #4).

evidence.description: Evidence references backing the status — the Verify: command and its real output, at minimum (GR-12).
